input.prompt: Hand-painted gouache miniature illustration, square composition, warm ivory paper ground. Visible brush strokes and dry-brush edges, muted ochre, eucalyptus green, ocean teal and terracotta. Painted scene, not a photograph, not a 3D render. Clear silhouette and readable shapes. No letters, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, gradients, glow, lens flare or drop shadows.
